home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Ailectra
home.faq1Q: Can Ailectra auto-login into every AI?
home.faq1A: Ailectra prioritizes official OAuth and API key flows. For providers without official integration, we provide a secure manual launch with credential copy — never automated injection or session hijacking.
home.faq2Q: Is it safe to store credentials?
home.faq2A: Yes. All credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. Encryption keys are environment-isolated and never stored alongside data. We follow industry-standard security practices.
home.faq3A: Absolutely. You can sign up and log in with your Google account via OAuth 2.0. Your Google credentials are never stored by Ailectra — authentication is handled entirely by Google.
home.faq4Q: Can I use multiple accounts for one provider?
home.faq4A: Yes. Ailectra supports unlimited account connections per provider. Manage personal and work accounts for Claude, ChatGPT, or any supported service from one dashboard.
home.faq5A: Yes. Ailectra fully supports English and Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) with a one-click language switcher available throughout the app.

security.heroDescription: Ailectra is built with security at its core. Learn how we protect your AI account credentials.
neverItems: Never reads your browser cookies or sessions
Never injects credentials into third-party login forms
Never transmits plaintext passwords over any network
security.encryptionDesc: Every credential is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. Encryption keys are derived from environment-isolated secrets, never co-located with encrypted data. Even in a database breach, your credentials remain unreadable.
security.launchDesc: Ailectra prioritizes official OAuth, API key, and deep-link flows. For providers without official integration, we open the provider's login page and optionally allow you to copy your credentials — never automated injection.

about.heroDescription: The future of AI account management, built for professionals who demand more.

about.missionDesc: To be the single, secure access point for every AI service you use. We believe managing your AI tools should feel as futuristic as the technology itself — fast, beautiful, and effortlessly secure.
about.principle1Desc: Every design decision starts with security. We never compromise user safety for convenience.
about.principle2Desc: Premium, futuristic design that makes everyday AI management feel extraordinary.
about.principle3Desc: We use OAuth, API keys, and deep links — never browser injection or session hijacking.
about.principle4Desc: Your data, your rules. Export, delete, or rotate credentials at any time.
